newsitem.title: USA: Kelley Oil tenders for $100 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Kelley Oil tenders for $100 mln in notes.

text.p: Kelley Oil & Gas Corp said it initiated a tender offer for its outstanding $100 million issue of 13-1/2 percent senior notes due 1999 and amendments to the indenture for the notes.
The company is offering to buy the notes at a price of 1,100 per $1,000 in principal, plus accrued and upaid interest, Kelley Oil said.
Holders who consent to the elimination of a restrictive covenent on the note and tender their notes before October 7, 1996, will ge an additional $30 per $1,000 in principal amount, Kelley Oil said.
Kelley Oil said the tender offer expires on October 22, 1996.

The tender offer is subjected to terms and conditions of the offer and solicitation, including obtaining $125 million in financing. Dealer managers for the tender offer are Morgan Stanley & Co, Chase Securities and Lazard Freres & Co, Kelley Oil said.
